tournament.name: Crokeyz Streets of New Capenna Tournament

decks.notes: This deck focuses on a fast and aggressive playstyle, utilizing a mix of powerful creatures and removal spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. By combining strong creatures like Lolth, Spider Queen and The Wandering Emperor with disruptive spells like Bloodchief's Thirst and Duress, the deck aims to apply constant pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The mana base provides a mix of colors to ensure consistency in casting spells, while also offering utility lands to enhance the deck's overall strategy. The goal is to outpace the opponent and secure a victory before they can stabilize.

This deck focuses on using a combination of powerful creatures and versatile removal spells to maintain board control and pressure opponents quickly. It includes a mix of disruptive cards like Duress and Vanishing Verse, along with threats like Kaito Shizuki and The Meathook Massacre to finish off opponents. The deck also includes some evasion in the form of flyers like Faerie Vandal and Obscura Interceptor to bypass blockers. Overall, the deck aims to be fast and aggressive, punishing opponents for any missteps while maintaining a strong presence on the battlefield.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage. The goal is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up for powerful late-game plays with cards like Magma Opus and Goldspan Dragon. This deck aims to maintain board control and outvalue the opponent by efficiently dealing with threats and generating card advantage. The land base is also built to support the control strategy by providing a stable mana base and additional utility with modal lands.

This Mardu Aggro deck focuses on quickly playing aggressive creatures and disrupting the opponent's strategy. The deck includes a mix of efficient creatures like Luminarch Aspirant and Valki, God of Lies, along with removal spells like Vanishing Verse and Hagra Mauling to control the board. The deck also includes powerful finishers like The Meathook Massacre and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to quickly close out games. By applying pressure early and disrupting the opponent's plans, this deck aims to win before the opponent can stabilize.

This deck focuses on quickly building a board with aggressive creatures and disrupting the opponent's strategy with removal spells. The creatures in the deck are versatile and can provide different forms of pressure, while the spells can deal with threats efficiently. The deck also includes a mix of powerful planeswalkers and enchantments to help close out the game. The mana base is carefully constructed to ensure consistent color access and smooth gameplay. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and efficient offense while controlling the board.

This Izzet Control deck aims to disrupt and control the opponent's board while building up their own resources. By using a variety of removal spells, counterspells, and card draw effects, the deck can maintain control of the game until they are able to close it out with powerful finishers like Burn Down the House or Big Score. The inclusion of key lands like Hall of Storm Giants and Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance allows for additional utility and flexibility in managing threats and advancing the game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to establish control over the game by using a combination of removal spells, hand disruption, and powerful creatures. The deck focuses on using cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Ob Nixilis, the Adversary to generate card advantage and outvalue the opponent. With powerful threats like Sorin the Mirthless and Lolth, Spider Queen, the deck aims to control the board and slowly grind out a win. Additionally, the deck includes a combination of lands to ensure mana consistency and flexibility in casting spells.

The deck revolves around quickly overwhelming the opponent with low-cost creatures and powerful spells to control the board. It focuses on building a strong board presence early on and using removal and protection spells to maintain control. Cards like Luminarch Aspirant and The Wandering Emperor help pump up your creatures, while cards like Portable Hole and Skyclave Apparition provide removal options. Elspeth Resplendent and Emeria's Call offer powerful finishers to seal the game. The deck aims to apply relentless pressure and win the game quickly before the opponent can stabilize.

The deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive creatures and disrupting the opponent's strategy with removal spells and disruptive creatures. It aims to pressure the opponent early with efficient threats like Luminarch Aspirant and Tenacious Underdog, while also using cards like Skyclave Apparition and Vanishing Verse to deal with key threats. The deck also includes planeswalkers like Sorin the Mirthless and Elspeth Resplendent to provide additional value and threats. The mana base is designed to support both the aggressive nature of the deck and its various color requirements.

The deck focuses on aggressive play utilizing a variety of powerful creatures and planeswalkers to quickly overwhelm the opponent. With a mix of low-cost creatures like Faerie Vandal and Luminarch Aspirant, as well as disruptive spells like Vanishing Verse and Bloodchief's Thirst, the deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain board control throughout the game. Additionally, the inclusion of versatile lands like Emeria's Call and Raffine's Tower provides additional utility and flexibility in adapting to different situations.

This Esper Aggro deck focuses on quickly developing a strong board presence with low-cost creatures and utilizing powerful cards like Skyclave Apparition and Vanishing Verse to control the opponent's board. It also incorporates cards like Raffine, Scheming Seer and Wedding Announcement to create additional card advantage and value. The inclusion of planeswalkers like Sorin the Mirthless and Elspeth Resplendent provides additional threats and ways to pressure the opponent. The deck's mana base is designed to provide consistent access to all three colors while also enabling the aggressive game plan.

The deck is focused on quickly playing and buffing Angel creatures to overwhelm the opponent. It includes powerful Angels like Elspeth Resplendent, Emeria's Call, and Firja's Retribution to gain advantage on the battlefield. The deck also includes cards like Righteous Valkyrie and Inspiring Overseer to further boost the Angel creatures. Additionally, it includes some counter spells like Negate to protect the creatures. Overall, the deck aims to aggressively play Angel creatures and quickly overpower the opponent with their strong abilities and synergy.

This deck focuses on using a combination of removal spells and powerful creatures to control the game and outvalue the opponent. With cards like Lolth, Spider Queen, Wrenn and Seven, and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, the deck aims to control the board while generating incremental advantages. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Unleash the Inferno and The Meathook Massacre to close out the game. By efficiently managing resources and disrupting the opponent's game plan, the deck looks to grind out wins through attrition and card advantage.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly overwhelm your opponent with aggressive creatures and efficient spells. By utilizing cards like Showdown of the Skalds and Rune of Speed, you can pump up your creatures and go for a fast finish. Cards like Kami of Transience and Runeforge Champion help you maintain card advantage and board presence. Commune with Spirits and Touch the Spirit Realm provide additional utility and card selection. The lands in this deck support the aggressive strategy by providing a good mix of colors and mana fixing.

The deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and powerful enchantments to buff them up. By utilizing cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Showdown of the Skalds, along with various runes and creatures like Generous Visitor and Runeforge Champion, the deck aims to apply pressure to the opponent early on and maintain a strong board presence. With a mix of creatures, enchantments, and lands to support them, the Naya Aggro deck aims to win the game swiftly before the opponent can establish their own game plan.

The deck focuses on fast-paced aggression with a combination of creatures, removal spells, and burn spells. The goal is to quickly chip away at the opponent's life total while keeping their board clear with removal. Cards like Ob Nixilis, the Adversary and The Meathook Massacre provide value by either dealing damage or gaining advantage when creatures die. The deck has a mix of creatures with low mana costs and damage spells to maintain constant pressure on the opponent. The mana base is designed to support the deck's aggressive playstyle.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy through a combination of removal spells, card advantage, and controlling the board. The deck aims to control the game by utilizing a variety of spells and planeswalkers to neutralize threats and outvalue the opponent. With powerful removal like Infernal Grasp and board wipes like Shadows' Verdict, as well as card advantage engines like The Celestus and Tainted Indulgence, this deck aims to maintain control of the game while slowly grinding the opponent out of resources.

This deck focuses on quickly playing aggressive creatures and disrupting the opponent with removal spells before finishing them off with powerful flyers and enchantment-based effects. It aims to control the board early on and maintain pressure throughout the game, using a mix of creatures and spells to push for victory. With a combination of versatile threats and disruption, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a swift win.

This deck focuses on an aggressive playstyle with a mix of removal, creatures, and Planeswalkers in the color combination of white, black, and blue. The deck utilizes strong creatures like Liesa, Forgotten Archangel and Luminarch Aspirant to quickly pressure the opponent while also including versatile removal spells like Infernal Grasp and Vanishing Verse to control the board. Additionally, the inclusion of Planeswalkers like Sorin the Mirthless and Valki, God of Lies provides additional threats and card advantage. The mana base includes a mix of pathways and utility lands to ensure consistent mana sources.

This deck focuses on fast-paced aggression with a mix of creatures and removal spells to control the board and overwhelm the opponent. It includes powerful planeswalkers like Sorin the Mirthless and Niko Aris, as well as versatile cards like March of Otherworldly Light and Vanishing Verse. The creatures in the deck, such as Luminarch Aspirant and Faerie Vandal, are meant to apply constant pressure on the opponent while maintaining card advantage with cards like Raffine, Scheming Seer. The mana base is also well-rounded with a variety of pathways and utility lands to ensure consistent casting of spells.

The main idea of this deck is to gain control over the game by using a combination of powerful control spells, card draw, and removal options. The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy, protecting its own key cards, and outlasting the opponent until it can secure a win condition. By using a mix of counterspells, removal, and card advantage, the deck aims to dictate the pace of the game and emerge victorious through its strong suite of control options.

This Jund Control deck focuses on board control, removal, and sustainability. The deck aims to control the game through a combination of removal spells like Abrade and Bloodchief's Thirst, along with powerful threats like Lolth, Spider Queen and Ob Nixilis, the Adversary. The deck also includes cards like The Meathook Massacre and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to maintain board presence and generate value. With a mix of removal, threats, and card advantage, this deck seeks to outvalue and outlast the opponent in a game of resource management.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with fast, aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells. By utilizing powerful green creatures like Old-Growth Troll and Werewolf Pack Leader, along with supportive cards like Esika's Chariot and Blizzard Brawl, the deck aims to establish a strong board presence early on and maintain pressure throughout the game. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Gala Greeters and Jugan Defends the Temple provide additional threats and value to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent.

This Naya Aggro deck focuses on utilizing powerful runes to enhance the abilities of its creatures and create a fast-paced, aggressive strategy. By combining efficient creatures like Jukai Naturalist and Runeforge Champion with cards like Showdown of the Skalds and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, this deck can quickly overwhelm opponents with a mix of board presence and direct damage. The inclusion of protective spells like Circle of Confinement and generous support cards like Generous Visitor help to ensure that the deck can maintain its pressure and outpace opponents in the early game.

This Naya Aggro deck focuses on utilizing Rune cards to enhance creatures and overpower opponents quickly. By playing aggressive creatures like Kami of Transience and Jukai Naturalist alongside powerful Rune cards such as Rune of Might and Rune of Speed, the deck aims to put pressure on opponents and maintain board presence. Cards like Runeforge Champion and Showdown of the Skalds provide card advantage and additional threats to overwhelm opponents. The mana base includes various pathways for flexibility and consistency in casting spells. In conclusion, this deck excels at fast-paced aggression and efficient combat interactions.

The deck focuses on aggressive creature plays, using cards like Runeforge Champion and Generous Visitor to grow your board presence quickly. Cards like Showdown of the Skalds and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker help you maintain card advantage and momentum. The deck also includes support cards like Rune of Might and Kami of Transience to provide additional buff and protection to your creatures. The mana base is designed to ensure you have the right colors available to cast your spells, allowing you to overwhelm your opponent with a fast-paced and powerful assault.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and powerful enchantments. By continuously playing out threats like Generous Visitor and Runeforge Champion, along with enhancing them with runes and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, this deck aims to quickly build up a formidable board presence. Utilizing cards like Kami of Transience and Showdown of the Skalds to generate card advantage and maintain pressure on the opponent. The mana base is designed to ensure smooth color fixing and consistent casting of spells.

Utilizing a combination of powerful creatures and removal spells, this Orzhov Aggro deck aims to overwhelm opponents quickly. With cards like Luminarch Aspirant and Reidane, God of the Worthy boosting your board presence and Tenacious Underdog providing resilience, along with efficient removal options such as Vanishing Verse and Infernal Grasp, this deck looks to apply constant pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of powerful planeswalkers like Sorin the Mirthless and Lolth, Spider Queen provide additional threats and resources to close out games effectively.

The main concept of this Selesnya Aggro deck is to swarm the board with small, efficient creatures like Illuminator Virtuoso, Clever Lumimancer, and Dragonsguard Elite, and then use combat tricks and protection spells like Sejiri Shelter, Snakeskin Veil, and Homestead Courage to keep them alive and deal damage quickly. The deck also utilizes pump spells like Charge Through and Guiding Voice to buff up the creatures and push through damage. The mana base includes dual lands like Branchloft Pathway and Overgrown Farmland to ensure consistent colors for the 2-color deck.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of small, aggressive creatures in the early game. Each card is chosen to provide strong early game presence and pressure, with cards like Luminarch Aspirant, Usher of the Fallen, and Hopeful Initiate. Thalia, Guardian of Thraben also disrupts the opponent's strategy while buffing your own creatures. The deck also includes a few larger threats like Skyclave Apparition and Legion Angel for late-game power. With a focus on fast, aggressive plays, this deck aims to quickly build a board advantage and secure victory.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy using small creatures known as "weenies" in Magic: The Gathering. By quickly dropping and buffing low-cost creatures like Usher of the Fallen, Hopeful Initiate, and Luminarch Aspirant, the deck aims to build a strong board presence early in the game. Reidane, God of the Worthy provides disruption against opposing strategies, while cards like Skyclave Apparition and Elite Spellbinder offer removal options. The deck also includes a bit of mana fixing and land versatility to ensure a smooth curve of casting creatures.

This deck focuses on quickly building a board of small, aggressively-costed white creatures to overwhelm the opponent in the early game. It includes cards that provide stat boosts to your creatures, disrupt your opponent's game plan, and generate card advantage through recursion with Legion Angel. The goal is to apply pressure from the start and maintain a consistent threat level throughout the match, while also utilizing powerful finishers like Elspeth Resplendent and Crawling Barrens to close out games.
